title: Formal Resurgence and Differential Transcendence in Lean 4 (stokes-vandermonde)
description: Lean 4 formalization of the Borel–Stokes–Vandermonde criterion (both autonomous and non-autonomous over C(u) with rotated rays and arbitrary finite pole orders) and unconditional machine-checked proofs of differential transcendence across analytic number theory, combinatorics, special functions, and mock modular forms. Version 2.0.0 adds: Hölder's theorem (1887) directly on Mathlib's Complex.Gamma and Real.Gamma; Hilbert (1900) / Ostrowski's theorem (1920) directly on Mathlib's riemannZeta; all even divisor-sum series L_{2m}(q), L_0(q), and the literal MacMahon plane-partition Euler product M(q) = ∏ (1 - q^n)^{-n}; meromorphic EGF-to-OGF transcendence (Pak–Yeliussizov families); unconditional differential transcendence of partitions into primes (OEIS A000607) and distinct-prime partitions (OEIS A000586) in literal Euler-product form via MediumPNT from the PrimeNumberTheoremAnd (PNT+) project by Alex Kontorovich, Terence Tao, and contributors; and weight-1 mock modular / Eichler integrals over C(u) including KRY/Duke–Li E_1(τ; χ_{-3}) and the cusp shadow η(τ)η(23τ). All 44 audited declarations depend strictly on [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] and pass fresh leanchecker replay. Google Gemini, OpenAI Codex, and Anthropic Claude assisted with the investigation, auditing, drafting, and Lean formalization. Independent specialist review is welcome.
